reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team: the ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **#4092**.

That comes from Ilse Varga's message in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55, a channel Dana is in. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I included that too.

Earlier this morning Dana told me privately that they guess the ticket will end up as OPS-5546 next year. That was only their guess, and they asked me to keep it to myself, so I left it out of the channel reply.
